description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers the publish ask, the runtime symptom whose cause is packaging (invalid hook call), the exports-map question, the workspace-range install failure, and a DE phrasing. Should-not-trigger covers the near-miss neighbours this skill is one word away from: authoring the component itself (ui-component-architect), the PHP twin (composer-packages), a commit-message question (conventional-commits-writing), a monorepo task-graph question, and a bundler performance question — none of which are package-surface work.
